summary: In the Sokoban builder the closed "Board size" row sat between the tools and the board; once every tool showed its name it pushed the board's last row below a phone's fold, and wide the board stopped at 424px with a 120px gap before its tools. The size, set once, now heads the notes (after the board on a phone, under the tools beside the board when wide), and the builder's board fills its column.
